description: Orchestrator skill for React-Native feature implementation. Runs the Android bridge, iOS bridge, and TypeScript steps. Use this when you want to do all layers in one command. If you only need one layer, invoke the focused skills directly: - Android Kotlin bridge only: react-native-android-bridge-implementation - iOS ObjC bridge only: react-native-ios-bridge-implementation - TypeScript layer only: react-native-ts-implementation Requires: a ticket ID (MOEN-XXXXX), a contract branch in 'mobile-sdk-contracts', and a target Android BOM version. iOS inputs (ios_plugin_version, ios_plugin_base_pr_url) are optional — if both are absent, the iOS bridge step is skipped (feature is Android-only or iOS will be done later). Run AFTER plugin-base-feature-implementation. Do NOT use for JS-only changes or before plugin-base changes exist.
